abstracted_predicate.name: INITIATES_DETACHED_ASYNCHRONOUS_EXECUTION
abstracted_predicate.definition: The action initiates a process in a detached, background, or otherwise asynchronous execution mode so that control returns to the caller before the initiated process terminates while that process continues running independently.

parameters.name: initiation_action
parameters.description: The action that starts the process using a detached, background, or equivalent asynchronous execution mechanism.

assertion_conditions: The action explicitly uses a background-job operator, nohup-style detachment, or equivalent asynchronous launch facility to start the process.
The invocation is structured so that control returns immediately or without waiting for process termination while the launched process continues to run.
The process is actually launched during the action rather than merely being registered or scheduled to start later.
exclusion_conditions: The action runs the process in the foreground and waits for it to terminate before returning.
The action only registers the process to start later on an event, schedule, or restart without launching it now.
No detachment, backgrounding, or asynchronous execution mechanism is present in the action.
